requiredbulletpoints.bulletpoint: Designed custom electronics, embedded firmware, and a Unity-based telemetry UI to monitor ~100 datapoints on a 250 lb combat robot across multiple competition seasons (BattleBots WCVII 2022, 2023 exhibition, 2024 mini-series, and upcoming 2026 Pro League), supporting live diagnostics, post-match analysis, and pre-tournament debugging.

bulletpoints.bulletpoint: Developed a Unity telemetry interface rendering live diagnostics with dynamic visualizations for broadcast integration and team decision-making.
